terms.definition: Mass of solute (g) ÷ volume of solution (dm³).
Moles of solute ÷ volume of solution (dm³).
Using a burette to find the volume of one solution that exactly reacts with a known volume of another, with an indicator.
terms.examiner: Separate Chemistry. Repeat until concordant results within 0.10 cm³.

terms.definition: The point at which the indicator changes colour, showing the reaction is complete.
terms.examiner: Add drop by drop near the end point and swirl.

terms.definition: Moles of the known solution = concentration × volume (dm³); use the equation ratio to find moles of the other; concentration = moles ÷ volume.
